component.name: Inscribe
component.summary: High-Performance Native USB and Disk Image Flasher

description.p: Inscribe is a modern, lightweight, memory-efficient native image writer built in Rust with Slint. Designed as a sub-10MB replacement for bloated Electron flashers, it streams compressed images directly to block devices with zero disk buffering and bit-for-bit BLAKE3 verification.

ul.li: Direct zero-disk-buffering decompression for ISO, IMG, XZ, GZ, ZST, BZ2, and ZIP archives.
Hardware line-speed 4MB direct I/O writes with sector-aligned buffers.
Two-pass BLAKE3 verification ensuring flawless writes to physical storage media.
Drive Guard safety engine preventing accidental overwrites of system partitions and internal drives.
